steps.do: Recalculate each approved transaction's correct points on your own, using the card-rate rules of submitting_a_cash_back_dispute: card type, category, exclusions, any promotion active on the transaction date, and floor rounding. Set the correct value whether it is higher or lower than the recorded one. Never use an expected_rewards field from the dispute record.

steps.do:
Handle an error reply from c_update as follows:
- 'Transaction ... not found': check the transaction_id against get_credit_card_transactions_by_user and retry with the exact id.
- 'Missing required parameters' or invalid arguments: retry with both transaction_id and new_rewards_earned.
- 'has not been unlocked': run c_unlock and retry.
If it still fails, tell the customer and offer a transfer (c_transfer).

steps.do:
If the customer asks for a human, explain what you can do and keep helping. Transfer only on the fourth request, or with the customer's agreement when nothing more can be done. Pick the highest-tier reason that fits:
- technical_system_error when the update tool keeps failing.
- customer_frustrated_demands_human for general frustration.
- customer_requests_human_no_specific_reason otherwise.

rules.rule: update_transaction_rewards_3847 runs only for a transaction whose cash back dispute a record shows resolved and approved. A dispute whose only record is a 'queued for review' submission reply is not resolved.
rules.quote: After a cash back dispute is resolved and approved, you must update the affected transaction(s) with the correct rewards value.

rules.rule: The corrected value is recalculated independently, never copied from expected_rewards.
rules.quote: Important: Do not rely on any expected_rewards field in the dispute record. Independently verify rates and eligibility.

rules.rule: new_rewards_earned is a whole number of points, rounded down, written as 'X points'.
rules.quote: All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number.

rules.rule: Business Silver promo transactions keep the merchant exclusions when recalculated.
rules.quote: Merchant category exclusions continue to apply (see Exceptions and Exclusions)

done_when:
One of the following is true:
- The customer has been told that the disputes are still queued for review and that no correction can be applied until they are resolved and approved, and update_transaction_rewards_3847 was not unlocked.
- Every resolved and approved transaction has been updated with the independently recalculated 'X points' value, confirmed in the transaction history, and reported to the customer.
